200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully deleted the specified user group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
any
— 400 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified user group.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to delete the group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management failed to delete the group.
